facts.fact: CriancaOrc_.png is a full-body frontal illustration with arms lowered, a narrower silhouette, green skin, brown/cream clothing and a small closed-mouth smile; its nonzero-alpha bounds are x=82..354 and y=94..559.
Both images are 408x560 Format32bppArgb PNGs, contain transparent, partially transparent and opaque pixels, and reach the bottom row y=559.
The visible Reed eye line is higher on the shared canvas than the child-orc eye line; the two characters are not normalized to a common facial height.

inferences.inference: Expression variants should preserve each character's own head position, silhouette, costume, crop, alpha edge and bottom contact rather than vertically normalizing faces across characters.
Reed's broad arm silhouette is more likely to collide with dense background detail near the side slots; the child-orc asset leaves substantially more transparent lateral space.

Both illustrations read as softly lit character art without a strong scene-specific cast; background lighting should remain compatible with warm neutral character highlights unless synthesis explicitly requests relighting.
The exact shared key-light direction cannot be validated from the isolated busts and must be checked in the composed 1280x720 scene.

risks.risk: Resolving Reed/Rheed implicitly would create divergent asset names or broken references. Mitigation: preserve existing Reed final.png and require one explicit naming gate for new files.
A picture-based background would sit above current bust ID 1 unless IDs are migrated. Mitigation: prefer the empty-map parallax route or approve and validate a complete picture-ID migration.
Expression art made on a different canvas or registration point will visibly jump despite valid PNGs. Mitigation: exact 408x560 export and overlay validator per character.
Global preloading of many portrait variants can inflate cache residency. Mitigation: preload only the final scene set and profile real residency on target hardware.
A 1280x720 Cut-In and background can overlap in memory during transitions. Mitigation: one Cut-In at a time, prompt cleanup and measured Playtest/profiling.
Static empty tiles do not prove parallax framing or background readability. Mitigation: validate both branches and the transition at project resolution.

The choice plugin owns visual state and cleanup beyond the image files. Mitigation: do not infer runtime behavior from InnButton presence; Playtest normal, hover, confirm, cancel/default and both branches.
